title: Risk Management Professional (RMP)
overview: This course is designed to prepare participants for the Risk Management Professional (RMP) certification. It provides comprehensive training on developing project risk management plans and maintaining risk registers. Participants will learn to perform both qualitative and quantitative risk assessments and devise effective risk responses. The course also covers setting key performance indicators for monitoring and controlling project risks.
audience: Risk managers, project managers, project office members, project sponsors, functional managers, senior management, and individuals seeking RMP certification. This course is worth 30 Professional Development Units (PDUs).
methodology: The course employs interactive techniques including group exercises, brief presentations by both the consultant and participants, practice exam questions, and simulations.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Review RMP exam requirements and the application process
Define key risk management terms and build a solid risk management framework
Plan risk management processes and manage the risk register
Identify project risks using various techniques
Perform quantitative analysis to evaluate the impact of risks on project objectives
Develop appropriate response actions based on risk priority
Monitor and control project risks through reassessments and audits
Identify leadership and communication skills essential for effective risk management

items.text: Introduction to the Project Management Institute (PMI)
Critical Success Factors in Risk Management
